best_for: Players Wanting More Power than Polyester

description.en: Babolat AddiXion+ is a reinforced multifilament designed to combine comfort, durability and power. Compared with the previous AddiXion, it offers up to 25% longer durability while maintaining the soft feel and elasticity expected from a multifilament. Slightly firmer than Babolat Xcel, it delivers more direct response and dynamic power, making it an excellent choice for club players who frequently break traditional multifilament strings.
description.zh: Babolat AddiXion+ 是一款强化型多芯球线，兼顾舒适、耐久与力量输出。相比上一代 AddiXion，其耐久性提升最高可达 25%，同时依然保持多芯线优秀的舒适性和弹性。它比 Xcel 略硬、反馈更直接、力量更充足，非常适合经常打断普通多芯线、但又不希望改用聚酯线的俱乐部球员。

description.en: Babolat RPM Blast is one of the world's most iconic polyester strings. Its octagonal high-density co-polyester construction generates exceptional spin, maximum control and outstanding durability. Designed for advanced players with fast swing speeds, RPM Blast is best known as Rafael Nadal's signature string.
description.zh: Babolat RPM Blast 是全球最具代表性的聚酯球线之一，采用八边形高密度共聚酯结构，可提供极强旋转、卓越控制以及极高耐久性。适合挥拍速度快、追求现代旋转打法的中高级及职业球员，也是 Rafael Nadal 长期使用的标志性球线。

best_for: Advanced Players Wanting Spin Without Losing Feel
Players Wanting More Comfort Than Full Polyester
avoid_for: Players Looking for a Low-Cost Setup
Players Who Frequently Break Natural Gut

description.en: Babolat RPM Blast 1.25 + Touch VS 1.30 is a premium hybrid string set combining the spin, control and durability of RPM Blast co-polyester with the exceptional feel, elasticity, comfort and tension stability of Touch VS natural gut. Babolat recommends RPM Blast in the mains and Touch VS in the crosses for maximum spin and control, while reversing the setup provides additional power, comfort and feel.
description.zh: Babolat RPM Blast 1.25 + Touch VS 1.30 是一套高端混合穿线组合，将 RPM Blast 共聚酯线的旋转、控制与耐久性，与 Touch VS 天然肠线顶级的手感、弹性、舒适性及保磅性能结合。Babolat 建议将 RPM Blast 放在竖线、Touch VS 放在横线，以获得更强旋转和控制；如果将 Touch VS 放在竖线、RPM Blast 放在横线，则会获得更多力量、舒适性与击球反馈。

description.en: Babolat RPM Hurricane is a durable octagonal co-polyester monofilament designed for players who want strong spin, reliable control and long string life at an affordable price. Its lower-density co-polyester construction provides a slightly softer response than firmer polyester strings while maintaining excellent directional control and durability. It is an excellent choice for competitive club players with medium to fast swing speeds.
description.zh: Babolat RPM Hurricane 是一款兼顾旋转、控制和耐久性的八边形共聚酯单丝球线，定位于高性价比竞技聚酯线。低密度共聚酯结构让它比传统硬聚酯更加柔和，同时仍然保持优秀的方向控制、旋转能力和耐久表现，非常适合中高级俱乐部比赛球员以及挥拍速度较快的底线型打法。

tradeoffs: Slightly Less Control than RPM Blast

best_for: Players Wanting More Power Than RPM Blast

description.en: Babolat RPM Power is a power-oriented co-polyester monofilament developed for players who want more ball speed without sacrificing the spin and durability of the RPM family. Its unique extrusion process and special surface coating create a crisp impact feel and distinctive sound, while maintaining excellent spin and long-term durability. It is best suited to advanced players with fast swings who attack from the baseline.
description.zh: Babolat RPM Power 是 RPM 系列中强调力量输出的高密度共聚酯单丝球线。独特的挤压工艺结合特殊表面涂层，使它在保持 RPM 系列高旋转和耐久性的同时，提供更强的击球速度、更清脆的击球反馈以及独特的击球声音。非常适合挥拍速度快、依靠底线进攻和重炮击球的高级及比赛型球员。

best_for: Advanced Players With Fast Swing Speed
Players Wanting More Texture Than RPM Blast

description.en: Babolat RPM Rough is a textured octagonal co-polyester monofilament designed for maximum spin and precise control. Its rough high-density co-polyester surface increases ball bite, while the octagonal profile further enhances rotation. The embossed logo helps reduce friction and improve durability. RPM Rough is aimed at advanced and tournament players with fast swing speeds who want aggressive spin and controlled trajectories.
description.zh: Babolat RPM Rough 是一款粗糙表面、八边形结构的共聚酯单丝球线，核心定位是极强旋转与精准控制。高密度共聚酯的粗糙纹理能够增强咬球感，八边形截面进一步提升球的旋转；表面压印设计则有助于降低摩擦并提升耐久性。非常适合挥拍速度快、追求重上旋与攻击性弹道的高级和比赛型球员。

recommended_use: Players Transitioning from Multifilament to Monofilament
Players Seeking More Durability than Multifilament

tradeoffs: Less Maximum Spin than Shaped Polyester
Less Firm Control than RPM Blast

best_for: Players Who Find Polyester Too Stiff
Players Whose Multifilament Breaks Too Quickly
Players Wanting Moderate Spin Without Harshness
avoid_for: Very Fast Swing Players Wanting Maximum Spin
Players Who Prefer Very Firm Polyester Feel

description.en: Babolat RPM Soft is a unique polyamide monofilament designed to bridge the gap between multifilament comfort and monofilament durability. Its flexible polyamide construction provides significantly more comfort than traditional polyester strings, while its monofilament structure and double aramid coating improve durability compared with standard multifilaments. It is especially suitable for players transitioning into monofilament strings or those who want more spin and durability without the stiffness of polyester.
description.zh: Babolat RPM Soft 是一款非常特别的聚酰胺单丝球线，定位介于传统多芯线与聚酯单丝之间。聚酰胺材质比聚酯和共聚酯更柔软、更有弹性，因此拥有非常出色的舒适性；同时单丝结构和双层芳纶涂层又让它比普通多芯线更加耐用。它非常适合第一次从多芯线过渡到单丝球线的球员，或者希望获得更多旋转与耐久表现、但又不想承受传统聚酯线硬度的使用者。

recommended_use: Players Seeking More Tolerance than RPM Blast

tradeoffs: Slightly Less Maximum Control than Firmer Polyester

best_for: Players Who Like RPM Blast but Want More Comfort
Players Seeking Better Tolerance from Polyester
avoid_for: Beginners With Very Slow Swing Speed
Players Wanting the Firmest Possible Control Response

description.en: Babolat RPM Team is a softer spin-oriented co-polyester string designed for players who want the control and spin of the RPM family with a more forgiving response. Its octagonal profile improves ball bite and spin, while the low-density co-polyester construction produces a softer and more tolerant feel than firmer polyester strings such as RPM Blast. It is particularly well suited to intermediate and advanced players seeking modern spin performance without excessive stiffness.
description.zh: Babolat RPM Team 是 RPM 系列中偏柔和、偏容错的一款旋转型共聚酯球线。八边形截面能够提升咬球能力和旋转表现，而低密度共聚酯结构则让击球手感比 RPM Blast 更柔和、更容易驾驭。它非常适合喜欢 RPM 系列控制与旋转，但希望降低聚酯线硬度和提升舒适性的中高级球员。

design_profile.target_player: All Levels Seeking Maximum Feel and Comfort

tradeoffs: Sensitive to Excessive Friction in Full Bed

description.en: Babolat Touch VS is one of the world's benchmark natural gut tennis strings. Made in France from natural collagen fibres, it offers exceptional elasticity, power, comfort and feel while maintaining tension better than almost any other string type. Its long ball-contact time produces a uniquely connected response, and its tension stability makes it especially valuable in professional and hybrid string setups.
description.zh: Babolat Touch VS 是全球天然肠线领域最具代表性的产品之一，法国制造，以天然胶原纤维制成。它拥有极高弹性、强劲力量、顶级舒适性和极佳击球反馈，同时具备非常出色的保磅能力。由于球线与球接触时间更长，Touch VS 能提供非常细腻、直接的手感，并且特别适合与聚酯线组成混合穿线方案。

tradeoffs: Less Maximum Spin than Shaped Polyester

best_for: Players Seeking Comfort Without Excessive Power
Players Wanting More Control than Traditional Soft Multifilaments
Players Who Prefer a Crisp but Comfortable Multifilament
avoid_for: Very Fast Swing Players Who Prefer Firm Polyester

description.en: Babolat Xalt is a responsive polyamide multifilament designed to combine comfort, control and a firmer, more precise response. Its multifilament matrix absorbs vibration effectively, while specific polyamide fibres create a more reactive impact feel than very soft traditional multifilaments. Made in France using a solvent-free process, Xalt is particularly well suited to players who want arm-friendly comfort without losing directional control and responsiveness.
description.zh: Babolat Xalt 是一款强调舒适、控制与快速响应的聚酰胺多芯球线。其多芯矩阵结构能够有效吸收震动，而特殊聚酰胺纤维则让击球反馈比传统柔软型多芯线更加扎实、直接和灵敏。Xalt 在法国制造，并采用无溶剂工艺，非常适合希望保护手臂，同时又不想牺牲线路控制与击球响应速度的中高级俱乐部球员。

tradeoffs: Less Precise than Firmer Control Strings
Not Ideal for Heavy String Breakers

best_for: Players Wanting Easy Power and Forgiveness

description.en: Babolat Xplore is a comfortable and forgiving polyamide multifilament designed for junior, intermediate and recreational players. Its flexible polyamide filaments absorb vibration effectively and create a lively trampoline effect for easy power, while maintaining enough control for developing players. Made in France using a solvent-free process, Xplore is particularly well suited to players who value comfort, forgiveness and effortless playability.
description.zh: Babolat Xplore 是一款强调舒适、易打和容错性的聚酰胺多芯球线，主要面向青少年、中级及休闲球员。柔软的聚酰胺纤维能够有效吸收击球震动，同时通过良好的弹性产生明显的蹦床效应，让球员更轻松获得力量和深度。它采用无溶剂工艺并在法国制造，非常适合希望保护手臂、提升舒适性和降低击球难度的球员。

technologies.name: Live Wire Technology
technologies.description: Changes the molecular structure of the string to improve elasticity, resilience, power, comfort and control.

description.en: Gamma Live Wire is a premium multifilament tennis string engineered with Live Wire Technology to maximize elasticity and resilience. It delivers exceptional comfort, power, touch and arm-friendly performance while maintaining excellent control.
description.zh: Gamma Live Wire 是一款高端多芯结构球线，采用 Live Wire Technology 提升分子弹性与回复性能，提供极佳的舒适性、力量、手感及控球能力，同时对手臂更加友好。

description.en: Gamma Live Wire Professional is a premium multifilament string engineered to provide natural gut-like performance while maintaining outstanding comfort and playability. Its construction incorporates 50% more Iso-Elastic Fibers, NCP Tension Fibers for improved tension maintenance, and PEEK abrasion-resistant fibers for enhanced durability, producing a crisp, solid response preferred by advanced players.
description.zh: Gamma Live Wire Professional 是 Gamma 高端多芯球线，旨在提供接近天然肠线的击球体验，同时保持 Live Wire 系列出色的舒适性。它采用比标准 Live Wire 多 50% 的 Iso-Elastic Fibers、NCP 保磅纤维以及 PEEK 耐磨纤维，兼具优秀的手感、力量、控制、保磅能力与耐久性，适合追求天然肠线击球感但希望获得更高耐用性的球员。

description.en: GAMMA Moto is a high-performance heptagonal co-polyester string designed to generate exceptional ball bite, spin, control and responsiveness. AMP Technology increases resiliency for additional power and ball speed, while the seven-sided profile enhances friction with the ball to maximize spin. The 16 gauge Black version measures 1.29 mm and emphasizes durability and control, while the 17 gauge Lime version measures 1.24 mm and provides greater spin, elasticity and responsiveness.
description.zh: GAMMA Moto 是一款面向高水平球员的七边形共聚酯单丝球线，核心优势是强烈咬球、旋转、控制以及快速响应。AMP Technology 提升球线的回复性能，从而增加力量与球速；七边形截面则通过增强球线与网球之间的摩擦，大幅提升旋转能力。16号黑色版本为1.29毫米，更强调耐久、稳定与控制；17号青柠色版本为1.24毫米，更强调旋转、弹性、拍头速度和击球响应。

recommended_use: Players Who Do Not Break Strings Frequently

best_for: Players Wanting More Comfort than Polyester
avoid_for: Advanced Players Seeking Maximum Polyester Spin

description.en: GAMMA Synthetic Gut is an all-around performance string designed for players of every level and playing style. Wearguard fibres protect the exterior of the string, helping reduce friction and notching while increasing durability. Its balanced combination of power, control, comfort and durability makes it a practical choice for recreational play, club competition and training.
description.zh: GAMMA Synthetic Gut 是一款适合各种水平和打法的全能型合成肠线，在力量、控制、舒适性与耐久性之间取得良好平衡。Wearguard 耐磨纤维覆盖球线外层，可降低球线之间的摩擦和切槽磨损，从而提升使用寿命。非常适合初学者、俱乐部球员、训练用拍以及希望获得高性价比穿线方案的用户。

description.en: Gamma TNT2 is a premium multifilament string engineered to deliver explosive power, excellent comfort and responsive feel. TNT2 Technology enhances elasticity and energy return, making it an outstanding option for players seeking arm-friendly performance with balanced control.
description.zh: GAMMA TNT2 是一款高性能多芯球线，采用 TNT2 技术提升球线弹性与能量回馈，兼具力量、舒适性与击球手感。非常适合希望获得更柔和击球体验，同时保持稳定控制和良好动力输出的球员。

verified_fields: Colors: Black, Blue, Orange Pink, White, Yellow

tradeoffs: Slightly Less Spin and Feel than 1.27

best_for: Players Wanting More Spin Without Polyester Stiffness
Players Wanting Strong Control and Comfort
Players Looking for More Durability than Traditional Multifilament
avoid_for: Players Wanting Natural Gut-Like Maximum Elasticity

description.en: GAMMA TNT2 React Pro combines the patented TNT2 process with a proprietary low-friction coating and wear-resistant microfiber outer wraps. The reduced friction allows the main strings to slide and snap back more easily across the crosses, increasing ball bite and spin. Reinforced outer fibers help prevent notching and extend durability, while the TNT2 process preserves comfort, control and lively response.
description.zh: GAMMA TNT2 React Pro 将专利 TNT2 工艺与低摩擦表面涂层及耐磨微纤维外层结构结合。低摩擦设计让竖线能够更容易在横线上滑动并快速回位，从而提升 Snapback、咬球能力与旋转表现；强化耐磨纤维则可减少球线切槽磨损并提升耐久性。同时，TNT2 工艺继续保持良好的舒适性、控制能力和活跃的击球反馈。

best_for: Players Wanting Polyester Spin Without Harsh Feel

description.en: Gamma Verve Soft is a soft co-polyester monofilament built with AMP Technology and a co-extrusion process that combines a soft core with stiffer outer prongs. The three-prong profile maximizes ball bite and spin while maintaining excellent comfort, control and vibration dampening, making it ideal for aggressive players who want polyester performance without excessive stiffness.
description.zh: Gamma Verve Soft 是一款采用 AMP Technology 与共挤结构（Co-Extrusion）的软质聚酯单丝球线。其柔软核心负责提升舒适性并吸收震动，外层三凸棱聚酯结构则增强咬球与旋转能力，在保证控制力的同时提供更高的容错性，是追求旋转但又不希望传统聚酯过硬的球员理想选择。

tradeoffs: Slightly Less Durable Than Tour Sniper 1.30

best_for: Players Wanting Tour Control With More Comfort
Players Finding ALU Power Too Firm
avoid_for: Players Wanting Extremely Low Launch Angle

description.en: Grapplesnake Alpha is the softer and more powerful sister string to Tour Sniper. Designed as a premium pentagonal tour polyester, it combines excellent directional control with increased comfort, feel and ball speed. Its stable response under heavy impact makes it ideal for advanced players seeking tournament-level precision without the harshness of traditional control polyester strings.
description.zh: Grapplesnake Alpha 是 Tour Sniper 的姊妹线，在保持 Tour 级控制能力的同时，进一步提升了舒适性、力量和击球手感。它采用五边形共聚酯结构，击球反馈稳定，甜区表现优秀，即使面对大力量击球也能保持精准控制，非常适合希望拥有竞技级表现但又不喜欢传统聚酯过硬手感的球员。

recommended_tension.note: +2 lb above your normal polyester tension

description.en: Aspera Triplum is Grapplesnake's most technologically advanced polyester string, combining square geometry, an abrasive surface and diamond-shaped indentations to maximize spin while maintaining exceptional comfort, feel and tension maintenance. Despite its aggressive profile, it is softer than Alpha and delivers outstanding power, control and consistency for modern tournament tennis.
description.zh: Aspera Triplum 是 Grapplesnake 目前技术集成度最高的聚酯球线，结合四方形截面、磨砂表面以及钻石纹凹槽三重设计，实现极高的旋转能力。同时，它拥有远超传统方形聚酯的舒适性和击球反馈，甚至比 Alpha 更柔和。力量表现接近 Tour Mako Silver，同时兼具优秀的保磅和控制能力，是现代力量型底线打法的旗舰球线。

products.model: CES Neon Dust / Liquid Neon Dust Hybrid

best_for: Players Wanting Poly Spin With Better Feel

description.en: Official Grapplesnake hybrid combining CES Neon Dust mains for maximum spin, control and durability with Liquid Neon Dust crosses for comfort, feel and additional power. Designed as the flagship Poly/Poly hybrid in the Grapplesnake lineup.
description.zh: Grapplesnake 官方旗舰 Poly/Poly Hybrid 套装。CES Neon Dust 主线负责提供旋转、控制与耐久性，Liquid Neon Dust 横线负责提升舒适性、击球手感以及力量输出，是 Grapplesnake 最具代表性的官方混穿组合。

__catalog.lookup_name: CES Neon Dust / Liquid Neon Dust Hybrid

best_for: Players Wanting Round Poly With High Spin

description.en: Grapplesnake Paradox Pro is a next-generation tour string built with advanced metallic performance additives and proprietary manufacturing processes. It combines direct feel, outstanding precision, long-lasting playability and excellent comfort in a round-profile string with a mildly abrasive surface. Unlike traditional polyester strings, it requires almost no break-in period and maintains its playing characteristics until it finally breaks.
description.zh: Grapplesnake Paradox Pro 是一款采用先进金属添加剂与特殊制造工艺打造的新一代竞技球线。它拥有极其直接的击球反馈、优秀的精准控制、长时间保持性能的能力以及出色的舒适性。虽然采用圆形截面，但依靠微磨砂表面依然能够提供优秀的旋转表现。与传统聚酯不同，它几乎无需磨合，并能在整个使用寿命内保持稳定性能，直到断线为止。

manufacturer_data.recommended_tension: Approximately -3 lb from the player's normal polyester tension

description.en: Grapplesnake Soldier is a next-generation tour control polyester engineered around maximum tension maintenance and exceptionally long playability. Its seven-sided profile and micro-abrasive surface generate higher spin than Tour Sniper and Tour M8 while preserving a predictable launch angle. Soldier offers medium power, outstanding control and stability, and is designed to perform best when strung approximately 3 lb lower than a player's normal polyester tension.
description.zh: Grapplesnake Soldier 是一款新一代竞技控制型聚酯球线，以极高的保磅能力和超长的可打时间为核心设计目标。它采用七边形截面和微磨砂表面，在保持稳定发射角的同时提供比 Tour Sniper 与 Tour M8 更强的旋转表现。整体力量处于中等水平，控制、稳定性与耐久性均非常突出。官方建议比平时聚酯穿线磅数降低约 3 磅，以充分发挥其性能。

manufacturer_data.stringing_notes: Soft edges and slippery surface make the string relatively easy to install using standard polyester stringing practices

best_for: Players Wanting Softer Feel Without Losing Stability
Players Who Find Traditional Control Poly Too Harsh

description.en: Grapplesnake Tour M8 is an octagonal tour-oriented co-polyester string combining exceptional control, stability, durability and tension maintenance with a relatively soft yet crisp response. Its eight-sided profile enhances ball bite, while the slippery surface and soft edges provide a controlled, responsive feel without the excessive harshness associated with many tournament polyester strings. It is available in 1.25 and 1.30 mm gauges in a distinctive olive green color.
description.zh: Grapplesnake Tour M8 是一款面向竞技和职业级使用的八边形共聚酯单丝球线，在控制、稳定性、耐久性和保磅能力方面表现突出，同时保持相对柔和但依旧清脆的击球反馈。八边形截面有助于增强咬球与旋转，而较光滑的表面和柔和棱角则让它比许多传统竞技聚酯线更容易驾驭。提供1.25毫米与1.30毫米两种线径，并采用非常具有辨识度的橄榄绿色。

recommended_tension.note: String approximately 2 lb above your normal polyester tension.

description.en: Tour Mako combines the stability of Tour M8 with the feel innovations introduced in Paradox Pro. The mildly abrasive surface enhances spin without sacrificing launch consistency. Teal focuses on feel and comfort, while Silver incorporates aluminum for additional precision, stability and tension maintenance.
description.zh: Tour Mako 是 Grapplesnake 目前最先进的 Tour 聚酯线，融合了 Tour M8 的稳定性以及 Paradox Pro 的新材料技术。微磨砂表面能够增加旋转而不会提高发射角，因此仍保持极高的一致性。Teal 版本更强调手感与舒适性；Silver 版本加入少量铝元素，进一步提升控制、保磅和稳定性，更适合偏软球拍。

description.en: Grapplesnake Tour Sniper is a low-powered pentagonal co-polyester designed for ultimate directional control, exceptional tension stability and heavy-hitting tournament play. Inspired by ALU Power, Tour Bite and Max Power, it delivers a softer feel, lower launch angle and partially pre-stretched construction for improved tension maintenance while maintaining excellent spin and precision.
description.zh: Grapplesnake Tour Sniper 是一款低动力五边形竞技聚酯球线，专为追求极致控制、稳定性及重炮型底线打法而设计。它融合了 ALU Power、Tour Bite 和 Max Power 的击球特性，同时拥有更柔和的手感、更低的发射角以及部分预拉伸结构，可有效降低聚酯球线初期掉磅，同时保持优秀的旋转和精准落点控制。

manufacturer_data.target_player_description: Tournament players with very good technique and a powerful, fast swing.

crystal_core_technology.description: HEAD Crystal Core Technology uses a complex multistep heat-treatment process to influence the balance between power and control within the co-polyester string.

recommended_hybrid.hybrid_note: Its smooth round profile is less abrasive on softer hybrid partners than shaped polyester strings.

life_cycle.recommended_monitoring: Replace when explosive response, snapback or directional control noticeably declines.

description.en: HEAD HAWK is a Tour-level co-polyester monofilament designed for advanced players who want an aggressive combination of explosive power and precise control. Crystal Core Technology balances a crystalline inner core responsible for control with outer molecular chains that enhance power. The round profile provides predictable response, durability and strong spin potential while remaining relatively hybrid-friendly. The 1.20 mm version emphasizes response and power, the 1.25 mm version offers the best overall balance, and the 1.30 mm version maximizes durability and stability.
description.zh: HEAD HAWK 是一款面向高水平巡回赛及竞技球员的共聚酯单丝球线，核心定位是在爆发力量与精准控制之间取得平衡。Crystal Core Technology 通过结晶内核强化控制，同时利用外层分子链增强力量输出。圆形截面提供稳定、可预测的击球反馈，并兼顾耐久性与旋转潜力，在混穿时也比棱形聚酯更加友好。1.20毫米版本更强调爆发力与响应；1.25毫米综合表现最均衡；1.30毫米则更偏向耐久与稳定。

description.en: HEAD HAWK TOUCH is a high-performance co-polyester monofilament designed for advanced Tour and tournament players who demand exceptional control, touch and accurate feedback. Its Crystal Core Technology uses a complex multistep heat-treatment process to create a larger crystalline inner core, allowing HEAD to precisely tune the balance between control and elasticity. description.zh: HEAD HAWK TOUCH 是一款面向高级、巡回赛及比赛型球员的高性能共聚酯单丝球线，核心特点是极高的控制力、触球感和精准反馈。其 Crystal Core Technology 采用复杂的多阶段热处理制造工艺，通过形成更大的结晶内核来精确调节球线的力量与控制平衡。最终带来高度稳定、精准且具有优秀击球反馈的表现，非常适合挥拍速度快、需要精确掌控每一次击球的高水平球员。

description.en: Luxilon 4G is one of the benchmark control polyester strings in professional tennis. Designed with strategically aligned molecular chains and Poly-Ether-Ether materials, it minimizes tension loss while maintaining exceptional consistency throughout its lifespan. The string delivers outstanding control, stability and durability with a slightly cushioned impact feel. The 1.25 mm version offers additional feel and response, while the 1.30 mm version prioritizes durability and long-term stability. Used by Serena Williams, Venus Williams and Grigor Dimitrov, 4G has become one of the industry's standards for tension maintenance.
description.zh: Luxilon 4G 是职业网坛最具代表性的控制型聚酯球线之一。采用特殊排列的高分子链结构（Strategically Aligned Molecular Chains）以及 Poly-Ether-Ether 材料，大幅降低张力衰减，在整个使用寿命内保持极高的一致性。4G 提供优秀的控制、稳定性与耐久性，同时拥有比传统聚酯更柔和的击球反馈。1.25mm 更强调手感与反馈；1.30mm 更强调耐久性、稳定性及长期保磅能力。目前 Serena Williams、Venus Williams 与 Grigor Dimitrov 等职业球员均曾使用 4G 系列。

recommended_use: Players Seeking More Spin Than Standard 4G

1.25.recommended_player: Advanced players wanting higher spin potential while maintaining exceptional tension stability.

life_cycle.recommended_monitoring: Replace after noticeable reduction in snapback or spin production rather than tension loss.

description.en: Luxilon 4G Rough combines the legendary tension maintenance of the 4G family with a textured surface that enhances spin potential and ball bite. The dented surface increases string flex for a slightly softer feel while maintaining the outstanding stability, durability and control that define the 4G series. Engineered with strategically aligned molecular chains and Poly-Ether-Ether materials, 4G Rough minimizes tension loss over time and remains highly consistent even under demanding weather conditions.
description.zh: Luxilon 4G Rough 将 4G 系列著名的保磅能力与粗糙纹理表面相结合，进一步提升旋转能力和咬球表现。官方采用凹凸纹理（Dented Surface）设计，在增加球线弯曲能力的同时，带来比标准 4G 略微更加柔和的击球反馈，并保持 4G 系列优秀的稳定性、耐久性与控制力。特殊排列的高分子链结构（Strategically Aligned Molecular Chains）与 Poly-Ether-Ether 材料可显著降低张力衰减，即使在潮湿或恶劣天气条件下也能维持稳定表现。

recommended_use: Players Seeking More Comfort Than Standard 4G

description.en: Luxilon 4G Soft is the more comfortable version of the 4G family, engineered to preserve the exceptional tension maintenance and control of standard 4G while providing a softer, more forgiving response. It is over 10% softer than 4G, yet still retains solid firmness, durability and precision. Strategically aligned molecular chains help minimize tension loss over time, while the Poly-Ether-Ether construction supports strength, flexibility and consistent performance even in demanding weather conditions.
description.zh: Luxilon 4G Soft 是 4G 系列中更加舒适的版本，在保留标准 4G 出色保磅、控制和稳定性的同时，提供更柔和、更宽容的击球反馈。官方表示其柔软度相比 4G 提升超过 10%，但依旧保持足够的扎实感、耐久性和精准度。特殊排列的分子链结构有助于降低长期张力损失，而 Poly-Ether-Ether 材料则兼顾强度、柔韧性和稳定表现，即使在雨水或高湿度环境下也能保持良好可打性。

description.en: Luxilon ALU Power is one of the benchmark tour-level polyester tennis strings. Its proprietary poly-ether-ether composition with aluminum additives delivers a distinctive combination of crisp feel, control, power and responsiveness. The string is highly resistant to atmospheric conditions and manufactured with extremely low variance for consistent performance. The 1.15 mm version emphasizes feel and responsiveness, the 1.25 mm version provides the most balanced performance, and the 1.30 mm version emphasizes durability, stability and control.
description.zh: Luxilon ALU Power 是职业巡回赛级聚酯球线中的标杆产品之一。其独特的 Poly-Ether-Ether 配方加入铝元素，在清脆击球感、精准控制、力量输出和快速响应之间形成非常鲜明的平衡，同时对湿度等环境条件具有很强的稳定性。1.15毫米版本最强调手感、触球和响应；1.25毫米版本最均衡；1.30毫米版本则更强调耐久、稳定性与方向控制。

1.25.recommended_player: Advanced players seeking maximum spin and feel.

1.30.recommended_player: Players prioritizing durability, stability and directional control.

life_cycle.recommended_monitoring: Replace once control and snapback noticeably decrease.

description.en: Luxilon ALU Power Rough is the textured version of the iconic ALU Power polyester string. Its dented surface increases ball bite and spin while also allowing additional string flex, creating a slightly softer and more forgiving response than standard ALU Power. The 1.25 mm gauge emphasizes feel, spin and responsiveness, while the 1.30 mm version provides greater durability and stability. Roger Federer famously used ALU Power Rough in the crosses of a natural gut hybrid setup.
description.zh: Luxilon ALU Power Rough 是经典 ALU Power 的纹理版本。其凹凸表面能够增强球线与网球之间的咬合，从而提升旋转表现，同时表面结构也增加了一定的球线弯曲能力，因此相比标准 ALU Power 拥有略微更加柔和和宽容的击球反馈。1.25毫米版本更强调旋转、手感与响应速度；1.30毫米版本则更加注重耐久性、稳定性和方向控制。Roger Federer 曾长期将 ALU Power Rough 作为天然肠线混穿方案中的横线使用。

description.en: Luxilon Eco Power is a high-performance polyester monofilament made from 100% recycled materials. Its durable heavy-duty construction combines power, spin and control while retaining enough forgiveness for touch and finesse shots. The hexagonal profile grips the ball at impact to increase spin and help players control aggressive trajectories. Designed for versatile all-court players, Eco Power combines modern polyester performance with a more sustainable material platform.
description.zh: Luxilon Eco Power 是一款采用 100% 再生材料制造的高性能聚酯单丝球线，将力量、旋转、控制和耐久性结合在一起，同时在处理小球和细腻击球时仍保留一定容错性。六边形截面能够在触球瞬间增强咬球能力，帮助球员产生更多旋转并提高攻击性击球的落点控制。它非常适合打法全面、挥拍速度较快，同时希望选择更可持续网球装备的中高级球员。

description.en: Luxilon Eco Rough is a sustainable polyester monofilament made from 100% recycled materials. Its surface is dented at 45-degree angles to increase string flexibility and create a softer response while also enhancing ball bite and spin. Designed for players who want durability, control and additional rotation without the overly harsh feel associated with some traditional rough polyester strings, Eco Rough combines modern spin performance with a more sustainable material platform.
description.zh: Luxilon Eco Rough 是一款采用 100% 再生材料制造的环保型聚酯单丝球线。其表面以 45 度角形成凹纹结构，可提升球线弯曲能力，使击球反馈比传统粗糙型聚酯更加柔和，同时增强咬球能力和旋转表现。它适合希望兼顾耐久、控制、强旋转以及更舒适击球感的中高级球员，同时也是 Luxilon 环保系列中的主要旋转型产品。

Designed for ultimate precision, exceptional spin and excellent tension maintenance, it delivers a controlled response for ambitious players while providing a more sustainable choice without sacrificing performance.

description.en: Luxilon Element is one of the softest and most comfortable polyester strings in the Luxilon lineup. Its Multi-Mono Technology enhances touch, feel and ball pocketing while reducing the harsh vibrations often associated with traditional polyester strings. Designed for players with long, fast swings, Element combines remarkable precision and spin with a softer, more forgiving response. The 1.25 mm version emphasizes feel and control, while the 1.30 mm version provides greater durability and stability.
description.zh: Luxilon Element 是 Luxilon 产品线中最柔和、最舒适的聚酯球线之一。其 Multi-Mono Technology 能够提升触球感、持球感与击球反馈，同时减少传统聚酯球线常见的生硬震动。它非常适合挥拍幅度大、速度快，但又不喜欢硬聚酯手感的球员，在保持精准控制和旋转能力的同时提供更柔和、更宽容的反馈。1.25毫米版本更强调手感与控制；1.30毫米版本则更强调耐久性和稳定性。

Multi-Mono Technology and Luxilon's soft polymer construction help reduce harsh vibrations, making it one of the more arm-friendly polyester options in the Luxilon lineup. The 1.30 mm gauge adds durability and stability while maintaining the softer response that defines Element.
description.zh: Luxilon Element Rough 在 Element 系列柔和、舒适和高触球感的基础上，加入更粗糙、更具形状感的表面结构，从而提升咬球能力与旋转表现。Multi-Mono Technology 配合 Luxilon 较柔软的聚合物结构，有助于减少传统聚酯常见的生硬震动，因此它也是 Luxilon 系列中较为护臂的聚酯线之一。1.30毫米线径进一步增强耐久性与稳定性，同时保留 Element 系列标志性的柔和反馈。

description.en: Luxilon Natural Gut is a premium natural gut string engineered with a unique protective coating and carefully selected organic raw materials to deliver exceptional feel, comfort, elasticity and long-term tension maintenance. Designed specifically to complement Luxilon monofilament strings in hybrid setups, it offers remarkable shock absorption, outstanding responsiveness and durability that exceeds most synthetic strings. Available in 1.20, 1.25 and 1.30 mm gauges, it allows players to choose between ultimate feel, balanced performance or increased durability.
description.zh: Luxilon Natural Gut 是 Luxilon 推出的高端天然肠线，采用天然有机原料与专属保护涂层制造，能够提供极佳的手感、舒适性、弹性以及长期保磅能力。官方特别强调其针对 Luxilon 聚酯球线混穿而设计，在保持天然肠线优秀击球反馈的同时，拥有出色的避震效果、响应速度以及超过绝大多数合成球线的耐打性。提供 1.20、1.25 与 1.30 三种线径，可分别满足极致手感、综合平衡及更高耐久性的不同需求。

description.en: MSV Bussard is a crisp co-polyester monofilament designed for intermediate to advanced players who attack the ball with full swings and topspin. It delivers very high control and spin potential while special additives improve tension maintenance and durability. Racketpedia measurements supplied by MSV report control scores between 95 and 100 percent and spin scores between 85 and 100 percent depending on gauge. Bussard is recommended for normal and open string patterns, with an official tension recommendation of 20 to 24 kg. Made in Germany.
description.zh: MSV Bussard 是一款击球反馈清脆的共聚酯单丝球线，专为使用完整挥拍动作、积极制造上旋的中高级球员设计。它提供极高的控制力和旋转潜力，同时通过特殊添加剂强化保磅与耐久表现。MSV 提供的 Racketpedia 数据显示，根据不同线径，其控制评分达到 95–100%，旋转评分达到 85–100%。Bussard 适合正常及开放式线床，官方建议穿线张力为 20–24 kg（44–53 lbs），产地为德国。

Its smooth round construction provides excellent snapback and makes it particularly useful in hybrid setups. Independent testing has highlighted its power, control, touch, spin and value, while laboratory measurements have also shown strong energy return and reduced tension loss. description.en: MSV Focus HEX Ultra is an explosive, crisp and highly responsive hexagonal co-polyester designed for advanced players who want strong spin, minimal string movement and exceptional tension stability. Its six-sided geometry and strong snapback generate high spin potential, while a special coating reduces unwanted string movement. Innovative additives help maintain tension over extended play. The string has received strong independent testing results for overall performance, tension stability and value, and has been used as the reference string for German tennisMAGAZIN racquet tests since 2017.
description.zh: MSV Focus HEX Ultra 是一款强调爆发、清脆反馈和快速响应的六边形共聚酯球线，专为追求高旋转、低线床位移和优秀保磅能力的高级球员设计。六边形结构与强 Snap-back 提供出色旋转潜力，特殊涂层能够减少球线移动，而创新添加剂则强化长期保磅表现。该产品在多项第三方测试中获得非常高的综合评价、保磅评价和性价比评价，并自 2017 年起成为德国 tennisMAGAZIN 球拍测试的标准参考球线。

Its heptagonal geometry and twisted construction increase ball bite and rotation, while the elastic co-polyester material supports lively response and comfort. The 1.15 and 1.20 mm gauges emphasize spin, acceleration and feel, the 1.25 mm version provides the best overall balance, and the 1.30 mm version offers greater durability and stability.

description.en: Solinco Outlast is a durable, control-oriented co-polyester monofilament designed for consistent all-court performance and exceptional tension stability. Its high-powered polymer construction provides strong durability while retaining responsive touch and predictable control. Outlast is one of the strongest beneficiaries of Solinco's TruTension Technology and is positioned as one of the brand's best options for players seeking long-lasting tension maintenance and reliable playability.
description.zh: Solinco Outlast 是一款强调耐久、控制和全场稳定表现的共聚酯单丝球线。其高性能聚酯结构在提供出色耐久性的同时，依然保留良好的响应手感和可预测控制。Outlast 是 TruTension™ Technology 受益最明显的 Solinco 球线之一，核心优势就是超强保磅和长期稳定可打性，非常适合希望减少频繁换线、同时保持稳定线床反馈的球员。

officially_verified_fields: Longest levels of tension maintenance positioning

manufacturer_data.official_positioning: High-performance responsive co-polyester designed for maximum power, unbeatable control and precise manipulation of ball flight.

special_player_profiles: Players Wanting Strong Spin With Precision

life_cycle.recommended_monitoring: Replace when snapback, precision or ball-flight predictability noticeably declines.

best_for: Players Wanting Strong Spin and Precision
Players Seeking High Control With Explosive Power

description.en: Solinco Revolution is a firm, six-sided co-polyester string engineered for players with fast swings who want explosive power, high spin and highly predictable control. Its hexagonal profile increases ball grip and rotation, while the high-powered monofilament construction helps players manipulate ball flight with precision. Despite its relatively high stiffness, Revolution is designed to reduce vibration and off-center shock, providing a more controlled and comfortable response than its firm construction might suggest.
description.zh: Solinco Revolution 是一款采用六边形截面的偏硬型高性能共聚酯球线，主要面向挥拍速度快、追求爆发力量、高旋转和精准控制的球员。六边形结构能够增强咬球和旋转，而高性能单丝配方则强化对球路和飞行轨迹的控制。虽然整体刚性较高，但 Revolution 特别强调降低震动和偏心击球冲击，使它在保持清晰、稳定反馈的同时，具备比典型硬质聚酯更好的击球舒适度。

officially_verified_fields: Predictable response at fast swing speeds

manufacturer_data.tour_positioning: Extreme Spin / Power / Bite / Durability Polyester
manufacturer_data.official_positioning: High-performance versatile co-polyester designed to generate extreme power, intense spin and strong ball bite.
manufacturer_data.brand_positioning: Category-defying performance string focused on power, spin and pro-level durability.

recommended_hybrid.hybrid_note: Its firm shaped profile can create more friction against softer hybrid partners than a smooth round polyester.

tradeoffs: Very Low Durability Compared With Thicker Gauges
Less Spin and Feel Than Thinner Gauges

life_cycle.recommended_monitoring: Replace when ball bite, snapback or directional control noticeably declines.

best_for: Players Seeking Maximum Spin and Bite
avoid_for: Players Wanting Plush or Soft Co-Poly Feel

description.en: Solinco Tour Bite is a firm, high-performance shaped co-polyester designed to maximize spin, ball bite, power and durability. Its high-powered monofilament construction and aggressive shaped geometry create exceptional rotation and spin-based control, allowing hard hitters to generate a heavy ball while maintaining directional precision. With seven gauges ranging from 1.05 to 1.35 mm, Tour Bite covers everything from extreme spin and feel to maximum durability and stability.
description.zh: Solinco Tour Bite 是一款偏硬、强调高性能的异形共聚酯球线，核心优势是极高旋转、强咬球、力量以及耐久性。其高性能单丝结构与侵略性异形截面能够制造大量旋转，通过旋转本身提升控制，让大力量球员打出更重、更有压迫感的球。产品提供从 1.05 到 1.35 毫米共七种线径，细线径强调极致旋转和手感，粗线径则更偏向耐久、稳定和长期比赛使用。

manufacturer_data.tour_positioning: Extreme Spin / Power / Bite / Pocketing Polyester
manufacturer_data.official_positioning: High-performance versatile polyester string using a Diamond Rough texturing process to enhance power, spin, bite, pocketing, feel and playability.

diamond_rough.description: A textured surface treatment designed to increase spin and bite while supporting ball pocketing, feel and overall playability.

special_player_profiles: Players Seeking More Spin Than Standard Tour Bite
Players Prioritizing Surface Grip and Bite

recommended_hybrid.hybrid_note: The aggressive diamond-textured surface may create more friction against softer hybrid partners than a smooth round polyester.

life_cycle.recommended_monitoring: Replace when diamond-texture bite, snapback, pocketing or directional control noticeably declines.

best_for: Players Wanting More Pocketing Than Standard Tour Bite
avoid_for: Players Wanting a Smooth Low-Friction Polyester

description.en: Solinco Tour Bite Diamond Rough is a textured evolution of Tour Bite designed around a new Diamond Rough surface treatment. The diamond-textured construction increases spin and ball bite while an innovative co-polyester composition enhances pocketing, feel and playability. It retains the durable, high-performance DNA of Tour Bite while adding a more aggressive surface interaction with the ball. Available in 1.20, 1.25 and 1.30 mm gauges.
description.zh: Solinco Tour Bite Diamond Rough 是 Tour Bite 的 Diamond Rough 纹理强化版本，通过新的钻石纹理表面进一步提升旋转和咬球能力。创新共聚酯配方同时加强持球感、手感和可打性，在保留 Tour Bite 高耐久与高性能特点的基础上，提供更强的球面摩擦与旋转反馈。产品提供 1.20、1.25 与 1.30 毫米三种线径。

manufacturer_data.official_positioning: Official hybrid system combining Tour Bite polyester with Vanquish multifilament.

special_player_profiles: Players Wanting Polyester Spin With Multifilament Comfort

best_for: Players Wanting Maximum Spin Without Full Poly Harshness

description.en: Solinco Tour Bite + Vanquish is an official hybrid string system pairing Tour Bite in the mains with Vanquish in the crosses. Tour Bite supplies explosive spin, power and ball bite, while Vanquish's DuPont high-modulus polyamide multifilament construction adds touch, comfort and arm-friendly playability. The combination is ideal for players seeking the performance of polyester without the harshness of a full polyester setup.
description.zh: Solinco Tour Bite + Vanquish 是官方 Hybrid 混穿套装，采用 Tour Bite 作为主线、Vanquish 作为横线。Tour Bite 提供强大的旋转、力量与咬球能力，而 Vanquish 多芯线则利用 DuPont 高模量聚酰胺纤维带来更好的手感、舒适性与护肘表现。整体适合希望获得聚酯线性能，同时降低全聚酯线床硬度的球员。

manufacturer_data.official_positioning: A superior arm-friendly multifilament string offering an optimal combination of touch, control and comfort.

recommended_use: Players Wanting Multifilament With More Resistance

technology: DuPont High Modulus Polyamide Multifilament Core

special_player_profiles: Players Wanting Better Touch and Control
Players Transitioning Away From Full Polyester
Players Seeking a Soft Hybrid Cross

recommended_hybrid.official_hybrid_reference: Used as the cross string in the Solinco Tour Bite + Vanquish hybrid set.

life_cycle.recommended_monitoring: Replace when fraying, notching, loss of touch or reduced stringbed response becomes significant.

best_for: Hybrid Users Seeking a Soft Cross String
Players Wanting a Comfortable Full Bed
avoid_for: Heavy Topspin Players Seeking Maximum Polyester Spin
Players Wanting Extremely Firm Tournament Control

description.en: Solinco Vanquish is an arm-friendly multifilament string built around a DuPont high-modulus polyamide multifilament core and enhanced performance resin. It is designed to provide an excellent combination of touch, directional control, comfort and shock absorption while keeping power at a manageable level. Vanquish can be used as a comfortable full-bed string or as the softer component in a hybrid setup, including Solinco's official Tour Bite + Vanquish configuration.
description.zh: Solinco Vanquish 是一款以护臂、触球感和控制为核心的高性能多芯球线，采用 DuPont 高模量聚酰胺多芯核心，并结合 Enhanced Performance Resin 增强树脂。它能够提供优秀的触球反馈、方向控制、舒适性和减震表现，同时保持可控的力量输出。Vanquish 既可以整床使用，也非常适合作为 Hybrid 混穿中的柔和线材，例如 Solinco 官方的 Tour Bite + Vanquish 组合。

officially_verified_fields: DuPont High Modulus polyamide multifilament core

recommended_use: Players Who Do Not Break Strings Frequently

description.en: Tecnifibre Black Code is a pentagonal co-polyester monofilament designed for aggressive spin and trajectory control. Its five-sided profile increases ball bite, while Tecnifibre's Thermocore manufacturing process softens the natural stiffness of polyester for improved comfort. Black Code is available in Black, Lime and Fire colorways, with the Fire version available in 1.24 and 1.28 mm gauges.
description.zh: Tecnifibre Black Code 是一款五边形共聚酯单丝球线，以强烈旋转和击球轨迹控制为核心。五边形截面能够增强咬球能力，而 Tecnifibre 独有的 Thermocore 工艺则通过多阶段加热与冷却降低聚酯材料的天然硬度，从而改善舒适性。Black Code 提供 Black、Lime 和 Fire 三种颜色，其中 Fire 配色目前录入 1.24 和 1.28 毫米两种线径。

recommended_use: Players Seeking More Durability than Traditional Multifilament

description.en: Tecnifibre Duramix is a hybrid multifilament string combining 50% polyamide fibres for comfort and feel with 50% polyester fibres for firmer response, increased control and improved durability. High Density Polyurethane (HD PU) provides a firmer and more controlled feel than traditional soft multifilaments, while SPL surface treatment improves string movement and snap-back. Available in Natural and Black and in 1.25, 1.30 and 1.35 mm gauges, Duramix is particularly suitable for skilled players seeking comfort with greater firmness and durability.
description.zh: Tecnifibre Duramix 是一款混合多芯球线，由50%聚酰胺纤维与50%聚酯纤维组成。聚酰胺负责提供舒适性和击球反馈，而聚酯则带来更扎实的手感、更强控制以及更好的耐久性。HD PU 高密度聚氨酯让整体手感比传统柔软型多芯线更加紧实，SPL 表面处理则帮助球线快速回位并提升 Snapback。提供 Natural 与 Black 两种颜色，以及1.25、1.30和1.35毫米三种线径，非常适合希望兼顾舒适、控制与耐久的中高级球员。

description.en: Tecnifibre NRG² Natural is a premium multifilament string designed to maximize power and comfort. It uses more than 1,200 Elastyl microfilaments, which are more elastic than standard polyamide, and is fully impregnated with highly elastic PU400 polyurethane. The SPL surface coating reduces abrasion and improves snap-back, while the overall construction delivers an exceptionally lively, soft and powerful response.
description.zh: Tecnifibre NRG² Natural 是一款以力量与舒适性为核心的高端多芯球线。它采用超过1200根 Elastyl 微纤维，弹性高于普通聚酰胺，并通过高弹性 PU400 聚氨酯整体浸润，从而带来非常明显的力量输出与柔和手感。表面的 SPL 涂层可降低摩擦并帮助球线快速回位，提升 Snapback 表现。整体定位非常适合希望获得轻松力量、舒适击球感和较好弹性的球员。

1.25.recommended_player: Best all-around choice for most intermediate and advanced players

1.30.recommended_player: Advanced players, string breakers and powerful hitters

description.en: Tecnifibre Razor Soft is a comfort-oriented high-modulus co-polyester monofilament enhanced with polyurethane additives. It combines precise control with a softer and more comfortable response than traditional polyester strings. Available in Lime and Carbon colorways and in 1.20, 1.25 and 1.30 mm gauges, Razor Soft allows players to choose between greater spin and elasticity, balanced performance, or increased durability and directional control.
description.zh: Tecnifibre Razor Soft 是一款以舒适性为核心的高模量共聚酯单丝球线，通过加入 PU 聚氨酯添加剂，在保持精准控制的同时改善传统聚酯线偏硬的击球手感。目前提供 Lime 与 Carbon 两种颜色，并有1.20、1.25和1.30毫米三种线径。1.20更强调旋转、弹性和较高出球角度；1.25最均衡；1.30则更强调耐久性、方向控制及较低的出球角度。

description.en: Tecnifibre Razor Spin is a square-shaped co-polyester monofilament string designed for maximum spin and directional control. High modulus co-polyester provides excellent precision, while polyurethane additives improve comfort compared with traditional polyester strings. The square profile increases ball bite for enhanced topspin without sacrificing feel.
description.zh: Tecnifibre Razor Spin 是一款方形截面的高模量共聚酯单丝球线，专为追求旋转与控制的球员打造。高模量 Co-Poly 提供精准击球反馈，PU 聚氨酯添加剂则改善传统聚酯线偏硬的手感，提高舒适度。方形截面能够更有效咬住网球，提升上旋制造能力，同时保持稳定的方向控制。

description.en: Tecnifibre TGV is a premium multifilament string designed around two priorities: exceptional comfort and increased durability. Constructed with more than 1,200 polyamide microfilaments and a very high proportion of PU400 polyurethane, it delivers a soft, highly elastic response while improving resistance compared with traditional multifilaments. SPL surface treatment reduces friction and improves snap-back. Available in 1.25, 1.30 and 1.35 mm gauges, players can choose between maximum power and comfort, balanced performance, or maximum durability.
description.zh: Tecnifibre TGV 是一款以舒适性与耐久性为核心的高端多芯球线。采用超过1200根聚酰胺微纤维，并含有非常高比例的 PU400 聚氨酯，因此能够提供极其柔和、富有弹性的击球反馈，同时相比传统多芯线拥有更好的耐久表现。SPL 表面处理可降低摩擦并帮助球线快速回位。提供1.25、1.30和1.35毫米三种线径：1.25偏最大力量与舒适，1.30最均衡，1.35则偏最大耐久。

description.en: Tecnifibre Triax is the world's first Hybrid Multifilament string, combining polyester, polyamide and polyurethane into a single construction. It offers the comfort and power of a premium multifilament while delivering the control, spin and durability typically associated with polyester strings, making it one of the most balanced strings in the Tecnifibre lineup.
description.zh: Tecnifibre Triax 是全球首款 Hybrid Multifilament（混合多芯）球线，将聚酯、聚酰胺与聚氨酯三种材料融合于同一结构中。它兼具传统多芯线的舒适性和力量输出，同时拥有接近聚酯线的控制、旋转和耐久表现，是 Tecnifibre 产品线中最均衡、最全面的高性能球线之一。

description.en: Tecnifibre X-One Biphase is one of the world's benchmark premium multifilament strings. Manufactured in France with over 1,400 Elastyl and H²C fibres impregnated in PU400 polyurethane and finished using the exclusive Biphase pre-stretch process, it delivers exceptional comfort, feel, power and outstanding tension maintenance while offering multiple gauges to suit different player preferences.
description.zh: Tecnifibre X-One Biphase 是全球最具代表性的高端多芯球线之一。法国制造，采用超过1400根 Elastyl 与 H²C 微纤维，并使用 PU400 聚氨酯整体浸润及 Biphase 双向预拉伸工艺生产，拥有极佳的力量、舒适性、击球反馈及保磅性能，同时提供 1.18、1.24、1.30、1.34 四种线径，以满足不同球员对于旋转、耐久及手感的需求。

description.en: Tecnifibre X-One Biphase is one of the world's benchmark premium multifilament strings. Built with over 1,400 Elastyl and H²C fibres, impregnated with highly elastic PU400 polyurethane and finished with Tecnifibre's exclusive Biphase pre-stretch process, it delivers exceptional comfort, feel, power and outstanding tension maintenance. SPL surface treatment also improves snap-back for additional spin compared with traditional multifilaments.
description.zh: Tecnifibre X-One Biphase 是全球公认的顶级多芯球线之一。采用超过1400根 Elastyl 与 H²C 纤维，通过 PU400 高弹性聚氨酯整体浸润，并结合 Tecnifibre 独有的 Biphase 双向预拉伸工艺制造，使其拥有极佳的力量输出、舒适性、击球反馈以及优秀的保磅性能。表面的 SPL 涂层还能帮助球线快速回位，提高 Snapback 效果，使旋转表现优于传统多芯线。

description.en: Tecnifibre X-One Biphase Black 1.24 is a premium multifilament string designed to deliver gut-like comfort, feel and power while offering improved durability and tension maintenance. The combination of Elastyl and H²C fibres with PU400 polyurethane and the exclusive Biphase pre-stretch process creates exceptional elasticity and long-lasting performance. A silicone surface finish improves string movement and includes a visible wear indicator to help players know when restringing is needed.
description.zh: Tecnifibre X-One Biphase Black 1.24 是一款高端多芯球线，以接近天然肠线的舒适性、力量和击球反馈著称，同时拥有更好的耐久性和保磅表现。采用 50% Elastyl 高弹纤维、50% H²C 高耐热纤维、PU400 聚氨酯整体浸润以及独有的 Biphase 双向预拉伸工艺制造，使球线兼具力量、舒适性与长期性能。表面硅胶涂层改善球线滑动，并加入磨损指示设计，当出现明显起毛时即可判断需要重新穿线。

specifications.construction: Multifilament with Three Reinforced Monofilament Cores

description.en: Tecnifibre XR3 is a distinctive multifilament string that combines several hundred microfilaments with three thicker monofilament cores to create a crisper and drier response than traditional multifilaments. It retains strong comfort, power and durability while offering a firmer impact feel. Liquid polyurethane impregnation improves comfort and performance, while the built-in wear indicator helps players identify when restringing is needed before complete breakage. XR3 is particularly popular in Japan.
description.zh: Tecnifibre XR3 是一款结构非常特别的多芯球线，在数百根微纤维之外加入三根较粗的单丝核心，因此相比传统多芯线拥有更清脆、更偏干爽的击球反馈。它依然保留多芯线出色的舒适性、力量与弹性，同时增加一定的控制感和耐久性。球线通过液态聚氨酯整体浸润提升舒适度，并带有磨损指示功能，当击球区域出现明显起毛时，可提醒球员在完全断线前及时重新穿线。XR3 在日本市场尤其受欢迎。

manufacturer_data.official_positioning: Hybrid setup combining Toroline's highest-rated spin string in the mains with its slickest round string in the crosses for a comfortable, controlled and spin-driven response.

specifications.construction: Shaped Co-Poly + Round Low-Friction Co-Poly Hybrid

spin_system.description: The 101 Blend uses a shaped O-TORO main for mechanical ball grip and a slick round O-TORO SNAP cross to reduce inter-string friction and allow faster main-string return.

cross_function.description: The round O-TORO SNAP cross is designed to support more efficient main-string sliding and return while improving response consistency.

special_player_profiles: Players Seeking Maximum Spin From a Hybrid
Players Wanting More Snapback Than Full-Bed Shaped Poly
Players Wanting a Slick Round Cross

cross_string_role.primary_spin_source: Reduced inter-string friction and faster snapback

life_cycle.recommended_monitoring: Replace when main-string snapback, spin response or response consistency noticeably declines.

best_for: Players Wanting High Spin With Better Response Consistency
Players Who Like O-TORO But Want a Slicker Cross
avoid_for: Players Wanting Very Low Launch Angle

description.en: Toroline 101 Blend pairs O-TORO Black 1.23 in the mains with O-TORO SNAP White 1.25 in the crosses. The hexagonal O-TORO mains provide strong mechanical ball grip, control and spin, while the slick round O-TORO SNAP crosses reduce inter-string friction and allow the mains to slide and return faster. The result is a comfortable, controlled and highly spin-oriented dual-poly hybrid with increased string movement, fast snapback and consistent response.
description.zh: Toroline 101 Blend 采用 O-TORO Black 1.23 作为主线，搭配 O-TORO SNAP White 1.25 作为横线。六边形 O-TORO 主线负责提供机械咬球、控制和高旋转，而圆形低摩擦 O-TORO SNAP 横线则降低主横线之间的摩擦，让主线更容易移动并快速回位。最终形成一套以 Spin + Snapback + Control 为核心的双聚酯 Hybrid，在保持可控反馈的同时提升主线移动速度、Snapback 效率和整体旋转表现。

manufacturer_data.tour_positioning: Precision / Stability / Spin / Connected Feel Co-Polyester
manufacturer_data.official_positioning: Premium round co-poly engineered for precision, stability, elite snapback and explosive spin at modern swing speeds.

recommended_use: Players Wanting Greater Stability and Durability

spin_mechanism.description: A5 generates spin primarily through exceptional snapback and low-friction string movement rather than aggressive shaped edges.

round_geometry.description: The symmetrical round profile supports a clean and predictable launch angle with repeatable ball trajectory.

spin_physics.a5_solution: Because a smooth round string naturally provides less mechanical ball grip than a shaped string, A5 relies on elite snapback, low friction, elasticity and rapid string return to generate high rotational output.

recommended_hybrid.hybrid_note: A5's smooth round profile makes it particularly valuable as a low-friction cross for shaped Toroline mains.

life_cycle.recommended_monitoring: Replace when snapback, connected feel, trajectory control or directional consistency noticeably declines.

racketpedia.manufacturer_claim: Highest-rated Toroline round string for spin performance
racketpedia.tested_gauge_reference: Manufacturer product information attributes the 100/100 spin result to A5.

best_for: Players Seeking Elite Spin From a Round Co-Poly
Players Prioritizing Snapback and Low Friction
Players Seeking Stable Yet Lively Response
avoid_for: Players Seeking Maximum Mechanical Ball Bite From Sharp Edges

description.en: Toroline A5 is a premium round co-polyester engineered for precision, stability and elite spin without relying on aggressive shaped edges. Its refined polymer blend produces exceptional snapback, low-friction response and strong tension stability. Because round strings naturally create less mechanical ball grip, A5 generates much of its spin through rapid string movement, elasticity and powerful snapback. Racketpedia laboratory testing cited by Toroline rated A5 a perfect 100/100 for spin, making it the brand's highest-rated round string for spin performance. Its symmetrical geometry also produces a clean, predictable launch angle and repeatable ball flight. The 1.20 mm Infrared version provides a livelier response and greater feel, while the 1.25 mm Carbon Gray version emphasizes stability and control.
description.zh: Toroline A5 是一款高端圆形共聚酯球线，核心定位是精准、稳定、Connected Feel 与极高旋转表现。由于圆形球线缺少异形线锐利边缘提供的机械咬球，A5 主要依靠极高 Snapback、低摩擦、弹性以及快速线床回位来制造旋转。Toroline 引用的 Racketpedia 实验室测试中，A5 的旋转评分达到满分 100/100，使其成为 Toroline 旋转评分最高的圆形球线。对称圆形结构同时能够提供非常稳定、可预测的 Launch Angle 与重复性极高的球路。1.20 毫米 Infrared 版本更加活跃、强调手感与回弹；1.25 毫米 Carbon Gray 版本则更偏向稳定、控制与耐久。

officially_verified_fields: Highest-rated Toroline round string for spin positioning

manufacturer_data.tour_positioning: Plush / Crisp / Spin / Free Power Co-Polyester
manufacturer_data.official_positioning: Six-sided co-poly designed for players seeking a plush yet crisp response with ample spin and easy free power.

recommended_use: Players Seeking Softer Shaped Co-Poly Performance

hexagonal_geometry.description: The six-sided profile creates additional ball interaction and mechanical grip to support spin generation.

plush_crisp_balance.description: Absolute is designed to combine a softer, plush pocketing sensation with a clean and crisp response at impact.

free_power_response.description: The lively co-poly response helps generate easier depth and pace than more control-oriented firm polyester strings.

special_player_profiles: Players Seeking Free Power From a Co-Poly

description.en: Toroline VAMOS is a six-sided evolution of A5 developed in collaboration with Jonas Eriksson of Tennisnerd. Built from the same underlying platform as A5, VAMOS replaces the smooth round profile with a 1.23 mm hexagonal geometry to increase mechanical ball grip, bite and launch angle. While A5 generates much of its spin through elite snapback and low friction, VAMOS adds stronger string-to-ball interaction, creating a more pronounced spin response while retaining the connected feel and predictable control associated with A5. Exceptional tension maintenance and strong directional accuracy make it particularly well suited to aggressive ball strikers.
description.zh: Toroline VAMOS 是基于 A5 平台开发的六边形进阶版本，由 Toroline 与 Tennisnerd 的 Jonas Eriksson 合作研发。VAMOS 延续 A5 的核心材料与连接感，但将圆形结构改为 1.23 毫米六边形截面，从而增加球线与网球之间的机械摩擦、咬球能力以及出球角度。A5 主要依靠低摩擦和极高 Snapback 制造旋转，而 VAMOS 在此基础上增加更明显的机械抓球，因此能够提供更强烈的旋转反馈和更高的 Launch Angle，同时保留 A5 标志性的 Connected Feel 与精准控制。再加上优秀的保磅表现，它非常适合高速挥拍、积极进攻并重视旋转和方向控制的球员。

description.en: Toroline WASABI is a four-sided square co-polyester string designed for aggressive spin production. Its sharp edges create strong mechanical ball grip and bite, while a super-slick coating reduces inter-string friction and enhances snapback. This combination allows WASABI to generate spin through both direct ball interaction and rapid string return. Despite its aggressive geometry, Toroline also positions WASABI as having a softer response than many traditional shaped co-polys. It is available in Pomegranate Red, Neon Green and Neon Pink, all in 1.23 mm / 17 gauge.
description.zh: Toroline WASABI 是一款采用四边形 Square 截面的高旋转共聚酯球线。四条锐利边缘能够直接抓住网球毛毡，提供强烈的机械咬球和旋转；同时球线表面采用 Super-Slick 超光滑涂层，降低主横线之间的摩擦并提升 Snapback。因此 WASABI 同时利用 Ball Grip 与 Snapback 两种机制制造旋转。虽然外形非常具有攻击性，但 Toroline 同时强调它拥有相对柔和的击球反馈。产品统一采用 1.23 毫米 / 17 规格，提供 Pomegranate Red、Neon Green 与 Neon Pink 三种颜色。

description.en: Toroline Wasabi X is an ultra-slick round co-polyester designed primarily as a hybrid cross string. Its low-friction surface allows shaped or textured main strings to slide and snap back more freely, increasing string movement, spin efficiency and response consistency. The round geometry also creates a cleaner and more predictable launch angle while producing strong pocketing, explosive pop, easy depth and improved court penetration. Wasabi X is available in Neon Blue at 1.23 mm / 17 gauge.

data_quality_notes: The supplied title states PolyTour Fire 120/125/130 and the official item-code list includes PTGF130 and PTF130-2, indicating a 1.30 mm version. However, the supplied gauge specification table explicitly lists only 17 / 1.20 mm and 16L / 1.25 mm. The database therefore retains 1.30 mm as an available gauge based on the product title and item codes, while recording this specification-table omission here.

The supplied SIF technology paragraph states that SIF Technology uses a 'unique pentagonal structure'. However, the PolyTour Fire product specification itself identifies only 'Polyester (Monofilament)' and does not explicitly state a pentagonal cross-section. Because the supplied PolyTour Rev material contains similarly worded SIF copy while separately identifying Rev as octagonal, this database does not assign a pentagonal geometry to PolyTour Fire without model-specific confirmation.

description.en: Yonex REXIS Comfort is a premium nylon multifilament designed to combine softness, comfort, feel and ball pocketing. It uses Yonex's FRF (Fusion of Resin Filament) manufacturing process and molecular-level Plasma Bonding, with FORTIMO™ polyurethane developed by Mitsui Chemicals filling the gaps between nylon filaments to improve elasticity, repulsion and durability. Within the REXIS family, Comfort occupies the soft and high-pocketing area of Yonex's official performance map, making it ideal for players of all swing speeds who prioritize a plush, arm-friendly stringbed.
description.zh: Yonex REXIS Comfort 是一款以 Softness、Comfort、Feel 和 Ball Pocketing 为核心的高端尼龙多芯球线。它采用 Yonex 的 FRF（Fusion of Resin Filament）制造工艺与分子级 Plasma Bonding 技术，并使用 Mitsui Chemicals 开发的 FORTIMO™ 聚氨酯材料填充尼龙纤维之间的空隙，从而提升弹性、回弹和耐久。根据 Yonex 官方 Comfort & Playability 图，REXIS Comfort 位于明显偏 Soft 且具有较深 Ball Pocketing 的区域，因此它比 REXIS Speed 更柔和，也比 REXIS Feel 更强调纯粹的舒适和线床柔软度。

description.en: Yonex REXIS Feel is a premium nylon multifilament designed around superior ball pocketing, feel and control. It uses Yonex's FRF (Fusion of Resin Filament) process and molecular-level Plasma Bonding, with FORTIMO™ polyurethane developed by Mitsui Chemicals filling the gaps between nylon filaments to improve elasticity, repulsion and durability. Within the REXIS family, Feel sits on the softer, deeper-pocketing side of the official performance map and is intended for players of all swing speeds who prioritize connected feel and controlled pocketing.
description.zh: Yonex REXIS Feel 是一款以 Ball Pocketing、Feel 与 Control 为核心的高端尼龙多芯球线。它采用 Yonex 的 FRF（Fusion of Resin Filament）工艺和分子级 Plasma Bonding 技术，并使用由 Mitsui Chemicals 开发的 FORTIMO™ 聚氨酯材料填充传统 Multifilament 纤维之间的空隙，从而提升弹性、回弹力和耐久性。根据 Yonex 官方 Comfort & Playability 图，REXIS Feel 位于偏 Soft、Ball Pocketing 很深的区域，因此相比 REXIS Speed 更强调包球与手感，相比 REXIS Comfort 则更加偏向清晰反馈与方向控制。

description.en: Yonex REXIS Speed is the most response- and speed-oriented member of the REXIS multifilament family. Its nylon and polyester multifilament construction works with FORTIMO™ polyurethane, FRF (Fusion of Resin Filament) processing and molecular-level Plasma Bonding to improve repulsion, elasticity and durability. Yonex positions REXIS Speed for players of all swing speeds who want a highly responsive, lively string with added ball speed. On the official Comfort & Playability map, it sits significantly more toward the responsive and firm side than REXIS Feel or Comfort.
description.zh: Yonex REXIS Speed 是 REXIS 多芯系列中最强调 Response、Power 与 Ball Speed 的型号。它采用 Nylon + Polyester Multifilament 复合结构，并结合 FORTIMO™ 聚氨酯、FRF（Fusion of Resin Filament）制造工艺以及分子级 Plasma Bonding 技术，以提升回弹、弹性和耐久。Yonex 将它定位为适合所有挥拍速度、追求 Highly Responsive 和 Added Speed 的球员。根据官方 Comfort & Playability 图，REXIS Speed 明显比 REXIS Feel 和 REXIS Comfort 更靠近 Responsive 与 Firm 区域，因此整体击球感更加直接、活跃、快速，而不是单纯追求最柔软的线床。
